preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and n % 2 == 1 and 3 <= n < 10**5
preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is an odd integer between 3 and 10^5 (exclusive).

preconditions.expression: len(nodes) == n and all(isinstance(p, int) and isinstance(key, int) for p, key in nodes)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n node descriptions, each containing a parent index (integer) and a key (integer).

preconditions.expression: nodes[0][0] == -1 and all(nodes[i][0] != -1 for i in range(1, n))
preconditions.description: The first node (index 0) is the root (parent -1), and all other nodes have a valid parent index.
The number of search keys k is an integer between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: len(search_keys) == k and all(isinstance(x, int) and x > 0 for x in search_keys)
preconditions.description: There are exactly k search keys, all positive integers.
All node keys and search keys are distinct, where all_keys is the union of node keys and search keys.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p < n for p, _ in nodes if p != -1)
preconditions.description: All parent indices (except -1) refer to valid node indices in the range [0, n-1].

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly k lines, one for each search key.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(float(line) - expected_value) <= 1e-9 or abs(float(line) - expected_value) / max(1.0, abs(expected_value)) <= 1e-9 for line, expected_value in zip(output_lines, expected_values))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a real number representing the expected value of the search result for the corresponding key, with an absolute or relative error not exceeding 10^-9.

postconditions.expression: all(expected_value == sum(leaf_key for leaf_key in valid_mistake_leaves) / len(valid_mistake_leaves) if valid_mistake_leaves else 0.0 for expected_value, valid_mistake_leaves in zip(expected_values, all_valid_mistake_leaf_sets))
postconditions.description: For each search key, the expected value is the arithmetic mean of the keys found in the leaves reached by all possible search paths containing exactly one mistake.

postconditions.expression: all(len(valid_mistake_leaf_set) == count_possible_mistakes for valid_mistake_leaf_set, count_possible_mistakes in zip(all_valid_mistake_leaf_sets, all_possible_mistake_counts))
postconditions.description: The number of valid mistake paths for a key equals the number of nodes visited during the correct search path (excluding the final leaf where the search stops), as a mistake can occur at any decision point along the path.
